name: bridge-claude-codex
description: Asynchronous two-way messaging between Claude Code and Codex conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Send messages between Claude Code and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Find conversations and send text between Claude Code and Codex. Works with Claude and Codex in their desktop apps and terminals. Either side can start a conversation or reply. Windows uses native local transports; macOS reaches Codex through a configured SSH host.
defaultPrompt: Find the Claude Code session I name and send it my message.
Find the Codex thread I name and send it my message.
Open the conversation panel to search Claude sessions, read exchanged messages, and send manually.
Check the bridge status and recent outgoing deliveries.
